title: Spaniel Dog on Porch, Sunlit Patio Chair - Vintage 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming amateur snapshot capturing a floppy-eared dog (likely a spaniel or mixed hound breed) moving slightly as the photo is snapped, causing motion blur. The dog sits on a sunlit patio or outdoor porch floor beside a light-colored wooden chair. The print features an iconic decorative geometric Art Deco border trademarked by the Elko Photo Products Company, popular throughout the 1920s and 1930s in the United States.
